# netcup_firewall_policies (Data Source)

All firewall policies of the netcup SCP account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_firewall_policies" "all" {}

output "firewall_policy_ids" {
  value = [for p in data.netcup_firewall_policies.all.policies : p.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Firewall policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `id` (String) Policy id.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules in the policy.
